mentions.name: Stages
mentions.description: A Shopify app for managing imported orders. Its new Event Filters feature lets users set up rules that decide which orders should be imported into the app based on criteria such as Shopify product names, collection names, and order value.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on the finishing touches for a big new "Event Filters" feature for my Shopify app, Stages (https://getstages.com). The feature will let users set up rules to decide which orders should be imported into the app based on certain criteria like Shopify product names, collection names, order value, and so on.
mentions.author: nozzlegear
